verdict.rationale: Stripe's Checkout docs say a single payment-page integration can accept one-time and subscription payments from more than 125 local payment methods. Payment Links also let customers pay with their preferred payment method in their local currency. That covers the core idea of many local methods from one integration, but the pack never names the specific methods the story asks about. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of Apple Pay and Google Pay wallet support, named bank-redirect and BNPL methods, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
